body: GA — pre-commit hook flagged: index.html uses Chart.js CDN but local bundle exists at shared/chart.min.js. This is a medium risk: if CDN goes down during Kai's study session, charts fail. Please migrate index.html to use the local bundle. Pattern: replace CDN script tag with a path to shared/chart.min.js. — GP
